description: Owner-approved resolution of every route clash between a demonstration placeholder and a real (protected) resource in the private preview. A clash that is NOT listed here stops the build (fail closed): a real resource never replaces demo content by default, and grandfathering is not approval by itself. Stage 9.73 / 9.73A.

supersedesNote: These three were resolved by the Stage 9.38/9.39 supersession rule (OG-08 Stage 9.39, OG-10 Stage 9.41, OG-13 Stage 9.54): the real resource replaces the demo placeholder, and every reference to the placeholder follows it. That rule is superseded by the Stage 9.73 principle. Each entry names the one real id the placeholder may be replaced by; any other pairing is an error. Each needs an explicit owner ruling (supersede, with a written approval, or separate).

separateDemoStatus.res-0007: OWNER-APPROVED Stage 9.73 / 9.73A: the real Home Resilience Scorecard (res-1001) keeps /resources/home-resilience-scorecard/; the demo placeholder stays on /resources/demo-home-resilience-scorecard/, is hidden from protected listings, and stays reachable through explicit references (programme days 2 and 29, the demo Household Resilience Assessment).

separateDemoNote: A separated placeholder is never aliased to the real resource, and it is hidden from listings (library, Start Here, foundations, categories, collections, downloads); it is not deleted or renamed.
